title: Democrats, Newly Ascendant, Begin a Fight to Shape the Party’s Future
summary: At a moment of opportunity for the party, its long-feuding factions are seizing on the midterm results to make their case for tacking to the center or to the left.
body_markdown: At a moment of opportunity for the party, its long-feuding factions are seizing on the midterm results to make their case for tacking to the center or to the left.
